name: MonarchAiDisclaimer
title: AiDisclaimer
wrapsNative: HStack of an icon and Text; MonarchInlineNotice (a Label with a LabelStyle) for the high risk
summary: A short reminder that AI output can be wrong, worded and styled for a low, medium or high risk.
whenToUse: Under a chat composer (low), under answers people may rely on (medium), or beside answers people might act on, such as money, health, legal matters or deleting data (high).
whenNotToUse: Not to mark a single piece of content as AI-generated (use MonarchAiGeneratedBadge) and not for errors (use MonarchAiErrorMessage).
api: init(_ text: String? = nil, risk: MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk = .low)
enum MonarchAiDisclaimerRisk { case low, medium, high }

options.name: text
options.description: Replaces the built-in wording of the risk. Already localised. Empty text keeps the built-in wording.

options.name: risk
options.description: low, medium or high. Selects the wording, the icon and the look.

states.name: low
states.description: A centred caption in the muted text colour with the AI bot glyph.

states.name: medium
states.description: A leading-aligned line in the default text colour with an information icon.

states.name: high
states.description: A warning MonarchInlineNotice: a tinted strip with a warning triangle.

appearance: Low uses the muted text role and the AI strong role for the glyph; medium the default text role and the info strong role for the icon; high the warning subtle fill and the warning strong role, as MonarchInlineNotice draws it. All roles come from the theme, so the four themes, including high contrast, are covered.
platformNotes: Same three risks and wording as the web and Android. The web marks the element with role note, which has no VoiceOver equivalent; on iOS it is static text. Per-risk wording is replaced through the strings table or the text parameter rather than a messages object.
accessibility: The icon and text are one element, read as the text.
The low and medium icons are decorative and hidden.
The high risk is read with the tone name "Warning" first, so the risk does not depend on colour.
The text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps.
edgeCases: Long custom text wraps; the low risk stays centred.
An empty text falls back to the built-in wording.

examples.title: Low risk (default)
examples.code: MonarchAiDisclaimer("AI can make mistakes. Check important info.", risk: .low)

examples.title: Beside an answer people might act on
